results.content: # Inflation and the midterm elections. **INFLATION AND THE MIDTERM ELECTIONS.**On Friday, the Commerce Department released inflation figures for August, and what they show is … more of the same. Trump campaigned on a promise to bring down inflation, and millions of people voted for him to do just that. But it later rose, and now, after Trump has been in office 19 months, it is 3.4% in the new report.
